# Tempo

> Tempo makes plans with the people in your life. Your Tempo talks to your friend's, family member's or partner's Tempo, finds a time that suits you both and puts it in both calendars. Made by Tempo Software Pty Ltd in Brisbane, Australia. Private beta on iPhone.

Tempo is for anyone who keeps saying "we should catch up" and never locks in a date: friends lining up dinner or trivia, couples planning date nights, and people making time for a parent or sibling. Also known as Tempo AI, Tempo Assistant and Tempo AI Assistant. Website: tempoassistant.com.

## How making plans with Tempo works
- Every user has their own Tempo. You tell it what you like, what you'd rather skip and when you're free, and it keeps learning as you go.
- When you want to see someone, say so ("dinner with Mia next week, somewhere with pasta"). Your Tempo works it out with that person's Tempo, checks both calendars and both sets of preferences, and suggests a time with the reason behind it.
- Once both people say yes, the plan lands in both calendars. Nobody has to chase anybody through a group chat.
- Nothing starts until you say send. By default the other person gives a quick yes or no before anything is booked. People who opt in can let their Tempo book for them, with a 10 minute undo window.
- Planning is currently one-on-one between two Tempo users, for friends, family and partners.
- Privacy: each thing Tempo knows about you is shared or private. Private notes can't be read by any other account, and you can preview what another Tempo would see.

## How Tempo is different
Most planning apps only work for one person. Every Tempo can talk to other Tempos, so plans get made between assistants instead of across forty messages.

## What else Tempo does
- Daily briefing on your day, your week and your work.
- Calendar help when things clash, with Google Calendar and Outlook.
- Email: shows what needs a reply in Gmail or Outlook and drafts replies you send or save as drafts. Nothing is sent until you approve it.
- Notes: type or speak a note or task and Tempo saves it to the Notion database you choose.
- Quick add: events from plain English, typed or spoken.

## Key facts
- Platform: iPhone, private beta. Desktop and Android planned for public release.
- Pricing: Free. The waitlist is free too.
- Company: Tempo Software Pty Ltd (ABN 85 701 184 358), Brisbane, Australia; backed by UQ Ventures.
